answer: What survives to the prism is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The juniper is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the inlet. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, rewards vest against future work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
